purpose: Classify a bounded real treatment pilot before any paired A/B claim.
denominator_note: This is a 2/8 hard-v2 pilot. It does not score the remaining six hard-v2 cases and does not replace the v1 denominator.

interpretation.infra: No CLI process, workspace, API, or browser infrastructure failure occurred in the selected pilot.
interpretation.measurement: Both cases produced the expected terminal records and all four acceptance journeys; no contract or instrumentation failure was observed.
interpretation.builder: One case required one Core Builder revision before passing; this is counted as a successful closed-loop repair, not a terminal failure.
interpretation.release: Both post-publish fresh-browser audits passed, so no release-gate rejection occurred.
interpretation.causal_boundary: The pilot used the treatment/current profile only. It provides feasibility and evidence completeness, not a Prompt A/B causal estimate.
